headline: ATL @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ATL 4.55 at NYM 3.37, with a projected total of 7.93. Pitching context: Bryce Elder has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Matt Olson, Michael Harris II, Ozzie Albies, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Eric Wagaman, Eli White because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
